modules.summary: Split income into needs, wants and savings, and see why SIPs count as saving.

videos.title: 50-30-20 Rule of Money | Easy Financial Planning for Beginners

quiz.q: Under the 50/30/20 rule, which bucket does a monthly SIP belong to?
quiz.why: A SIP moves money into an investment you still own, so it is saving, not spending.

quiz.q: What is usually the easiest way to cut spending?
options: Cut the single biggest discretionary category
quiz.why: One large change sticks better than many small ones.

quiz.q: How many months of essential expenses is the usual emergency-fund guideline?
quiz.why: Six months covers most job searches or medical events; more if your income is irregular.

quiz.q: Which is the worst place for an emergency fund?
quiz.why: Equity can be down exactly when you need the cash.

quiz.why: ₹5 lakh, principal and interest combined.
